section: Important flagship programmes of the Central Government - social sector (health, education, nutrition, housing)
subsections: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri
Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM

accepted.s: Which Ministry is the nodal Ministry for the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
accepted.x: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare is the nodal Ministry for PM-JAY. Its implementation is entrusted to the National Health Authority.
accepted.tq: Identify the nodal Ministry rather than the implementing agency.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana is implemented by which agency?
o: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
accepted.x: PM-JAY is implemented by the National Health Authority under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
accepted.tq: Separate the nodal Ministry from the implementing agency.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: POSHAN is administered by which of the following Ministries?
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
accepted.x: POSHAN is under the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry-scheme association directly.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. PM-JAY — National Health Authority
b. POSHAN — Ministry of Women and Child Development
c. Jal Jeevan Mission — Ministry of Jal Shakti
d. NAMASTE — Ministry of Education
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: PM-JAY, POSHAN and Jal Jeevan Mission are correctly matched. NAMASTE is associated with the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, not the Ministry of Education.
accepted.tq: Find the wrongly assigned Ministry before comparing the codes.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission is under the administrative responsibility of which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
accepted.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission is administered by the Ministry of Jal Shakti.
accepted.tq: Test the scheme against the responsible Ministry.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NAMASTE is jointly associated with which two Ministries?
o: Ministry of Jal Shakti and Ministry of Education
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and Ministry of Rural Development
Ministry of Labour and Employment and Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: NAMASTE is associated with the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related social-sector Ministries.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Scheme for Economic Empowerment of Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (SEED), consider the following statements:
1. It is a Central Sector scheme.
2. It is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
3. It provides PM-JAY coverage and PMAY housing support.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: SEED is a Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and includes PM-JAY coverage and PMAY housing support.
accepted.tq: Combine scheme type, nodal Ministry and benefits.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SEED was launched in 2022 with an allocation of ₹200 crore spread over which period?
accepted.x: SEED was introduced in 2022 with ₹200 crore to be spent over five years.
accepted.tq: Recall the paired year, allocation and implementation period.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How much was allocated to the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27?
accepted.x: The Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust, associated with Aarogyasri, received ₹4,000 crore in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Use the exact budget figure, not a neighbouring scheme allocation.
accepted.sec: Scheme → nodal ministry / agency; AP Aarogyasri  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Swachh Bharat Mission was launched on which date?
accepted.x: Swachh Bharat Mission was launched on 2 October 2014.
accepted.tq: Match the flagship programme with its launch date.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The principal target of Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin Phase II is to create which of the following?
o: Functional tap connections in every urban household
accepted.x: SBM-Gramin Phase II focuses on ODF Plus villages. Garbage-free cities are the principal target of SBM-Urban 2.0.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the rural and urban phases of the sanitation mission.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: SBM-Urban 2.0 primarily targets which of the following?
accepted.x: SBM-Urban 2.0, launched in 2021, targets garbage-free cities.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact urban mission objective.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In the Union Budget 2026–27, the allocation for SBM-Urban was reduced from ₹5,000 crore to:
accepted.x: The SBM-Urban allocation was halved from ₹5,000 crore to ₹2,500 crore in the Union Budget 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Track the direction and exact amount of a budget change.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a feature of NAMASTE?
o: Direct cash transfer of ₹10,000 to every urban household
accepted.x: NAMASTE profiles workers, provides PM-JAY coverage, training with a ₹3,000 stipend and PPE. A ₹10,000 cash transfer to every urban household is not a stated feature.
accepted.tq: Find the option that does not belong to the scheme package.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The new phase of NAMASTE covers how many AMRUT cities?
accepted.x: The new phase of NAMASTE covers 500 AMRUT cities and includes Emergency Response Sanitation Units and PMKVY training.
accepted.tq: Recall the precise coverage number attached to the new phase.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The India Sanitation Coalition is best described as a multi-stakeholder platform led by:
accepted.x: The India Sanitation Coalition is a multi-stakeholder platform led by FICCI and was established in 2015.
accepted.tq: Identify the lead institution rather than a government department.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Jal Jeevan Mission:
1. It was launched in 2019.
2. It seeks to provide a Functional Household Tap Connection to every rural home.
3. Village Water and Sanitation Committees plan and operate the water supply.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe the Jal Jeevan Mission.
accepted.tq: Verify the launch year, objective and local implementation structure together.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which project is associated with the Andhra Pradesh link of the Jal Jeevan Mission?
accepted.x: The Madanapalle Water Grid in Rayalaseema is associated with the Andhra Pradesh link of the Jal Jeevan Mission.
accepted.tq: Use the location-project association as the deciding clue.
accepted.sec: Sanitation and drinking water - SBM, NAMASTE, ISC, JJM  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which pair is correctly matched?

Scheme — Premium

1. PMJJBY — ₹436 per year
2. PMSBY — ₹20 per year
3. Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana — ₹200

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The listed premiums are ₹436 annually for PMJJBY, ₹20 annually for PMSBY and ₹200 for Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana.
accepted.tq: Check each scheme against its exact premium before selecting the code.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly distinguishes PMJJBY from PMSBY?
o: PMJJBY provides accident cover, whereas PMSBY provides old-age pension.
PMJJBY provides life insurance, whereas PMSBY provides accident death and disability cover.
Both schemes provide only disability cover.
Both schemes provide life cover for rural landless households.
accepted.x: PMJJBY is a one-year renewable term life insurance scheme. PMSBY covers accidental death and disability.
accepted.tq: Separate the similar-looking schemes by the nature of their cover.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The entry age for PMJJBY and PMSBY is respectively:
accepted.x: PMJJBY is available to persons aged 18–50 years, while PMSBY covers persons aged 18–70 years.
accepted.tq: Compare the age bands of two closely related insurance schemes.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding PMSBY is correct?
o: It is a pension scheme for unorganised workers.
It covers suicide as an accidental death.
It provides ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability.
accepted.x: PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability. It does not cover suicide.
accepted.tq: Use the benefit amounts and the exclusion to reject neighbouring schemes.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. It covers rural landless households.
2. The premium is shared equally by the Centre and the State.
3. It provides ₹30,000 for natural death and ₹75,000 for accidental death.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The scheme provides life and disability cover for rural landless households, with the ₹200 premium shared 50:50 by the Centre and State.
accepted.tq: Combine beneficiary category, financing pattern and benefit amounts.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Atal Pension Yojana is primarily intended for which sector?
accepted.x: Atal Pension Yojana is a pension scheme intended for workers in the unorganised sector.
accepted.tq: Identify the target sector rather than the type of insurance cover.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. Atal Pension Yojana — 9 May 2015
2. eShram portal — 26 August 2021
3. Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana — 2 October 2007

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Atal Pension Yojana was launched on 9 May 2015, eShram was launched on 26 August 2021, and Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana dates to 2 October 2007.
accepted.tq: Cross-check each date against the corresponding programme.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The eShram portal creates a national database of unorganised workers and provides each worker with a:
accepted.x: The eShram portal is the National Database of Unorganised Workers and provides a Universal Account Number (UAN).
accepted.tq: Match the portal with its distinctive identification number.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The cover year for PMJJBY and PMSBY generally runs from:
accepted.x: The insurance cover year for PMJJBY and PMSBY runs from 1 June to 31 May, with auto-debit of the premium.
accepted.tq: Recall the scheme year rather than the financial year.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which organisation administers the dedicated Health Insurance Scheme for handloom weavers mentioned in the social-insurance framework?
o: Small Industries Development Bank of India
accepted.x: A dedicated Health Insurance Scheme for handloom weavers was introduced in 2005–06, while life cover was provided under the Converged Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana. The relevant insurance institution in the stated framework is LIC.
accepted.tq: Link the occupational group with the named insurance institution.
accepted.sec: Social insurance → cover and premium  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PMAY-G was restructured from which earlier rural housing programme?
o: Basic Services to the Urban Poor
accepted.x: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin was restructured from Indira Awaas Yojana. IAY began in 1985 and became independent in 1996.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the predecessor of the rural scheme from the urban housing schemes.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: The target under PMAY-G for the period 2016–17 to 2023–24 was approximately:
accepted.x: PMAY-G targeted 2.95 crore houses during 2016–17 to 2023–24.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact target rather than the later additional target.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under PMAY-G, the minimum floor area of a house is:
accepted.x: The minimum unit size under PMAY-G is 25 square metres.
accepted.tq: Use the precise unit-size figure as the discriminator.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: The unit assistance under PMAY-G is ₹1.20 lakh in plains and:
accepted.x: PMAY-G provides unit assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly areas.
accepted.tq: Compare the plains and hilly-area assistance amounts.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Centre-State cost-sharing ratio under PMAY-G is generally 60:40, while for the North-Eastern and Himalayan States it is:
accepted.x: The PMAY-G cost-sharing ratio is 60:40 generally and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States.
accepted.tq: Compare the general ratio with the special regional ratio.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: Beneficiaries under PMAY-G are selected primarily on the basis of:
accepted.x: Selection of PMAY-G beneficiaries is based on housing deprivation.
accepted.tq: Identify the actual eligibility principle instead of an assumed demographic criterion.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT a component of PMAY-U?
accepted.x: The PMAY-U components include in-situ slum redevelopment, credit-linked subsidy, affordable housing in partnership and beneficiary-led construction. Rural tap-water supply belongs to the Jal Jeevan Mission.
accepted.tq: Eliminate the item belonging to a different flagship programme.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: PMAY-U 2.0, introduced in 2024, targets construction of how many urban houses?
accepted.x: PMAY-U 2.0 targets 1 crore urban houses.
accepted.tq: Recall the target number attached to the revised urban phase.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding Housing for All and PMAY-G?
o: Housing for All was initially targeted for 2022, while PMAY-G has been extended to 2028–29.
Housing for All was initially targeted for 2028–29, while PMAY-G ended in 2022.
Both programmes were initially targeted only for 2016–17.
Neither programme has a specified time horizon.
accepted.x: Housing for All was initially targeted for 2022, and PMAY-G has subsequently been extended to 2028–29.
accepted.tq: Compare the time horizons of two related housing initiatives.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: The registration of houses in women's names under PMAY is associated with the description of PMAY as a:
accepted.x: Registration of houses in women's names gives PMAY the character of a gender-budget scheme.
accepted.tq: Link the implementation feature with its policy classification.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s: Rajiv Awas Yojana was primarily aimed at:
accepted.x: Rajiv Awas Yojana aimed at creating a slum-free India and was subsumed into PMAY-U in 2015.
accepted.tq: Identify the original objective before testing its successor relationship.
accepted.sec: Housing - PMAY-G, PMAY-U, Housing for All, RAY  [other exams]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Launch of eShram portal
B. Launch of Swachh Bharat Mission
C. Launch of Jal Jeevan Mission
D. Launch of Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana
accepted.x: Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana was launched in 2007, Swachh Bharat Mission in 2014, Jal Jeevan Mission in 2019 and eShram in 2021.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest events first, then place the middle dates.
